clean_host_confirmed.note: Confirm this was the approved clean/replacement pilot host and reference the change/deployment record; do not paste secrets or customer data.

https_secure_cookie_csrf.note: Record authenticated browser/API verification for HTTPS redirect, Secure cookies, CSRF trusted-origin behavior and forwarded HTTPS handling.

restore_marker_proof.note: Confirm the pre-backup marker exists after restore and the post-backup marker does not.

object_evidence_checksum.note: Confirm at least one restored Evidence object downloads successfully and its application checksum matches. Reference IDs/checksums only; do not embed payloads.

internet_egress_blocked_during_ai.note: Confirm internet egress was blocked during the local-model generation and embedding acceptance test.

ai_disable_provider_switch.note: Confirm AI-disabled mode and provider switching were exercised on the pilot without domain-code changes.

monitoring_logging_health.note: Confirm health endpoints, worker/background processing, monitoring and approved log review worked on the pilot host.

rpo_accepted.note: Record the measured recoverable cutoff from controlled marker evidence and whether it meets the approved RPO objective.

rto_accepted.note: Review observed_rto_seconds plus required manual validation time and record whether the result meets the approved RTO objective.

ai_human_review.note: Human-review the complete real-model adversarial responses outside the low-risk bundle and record the security decision.

scanner_real_validation.note: Record authorized real malware-scanner clean/infected/unavailable-path validation and signature-update evidence.

audit_immutable_storage_validation.note: Record deployment-level immutable/WORM or approved external audit-checkpoint validation where required.

pentest_completed_or_scheduled.note: Record the independent penetration-test report/retest or formally approved schedule reference.
